approved_payload.content: Police say a 35-year-old woman was shot dead at about 11 pm on Tuesday 13 October at a house in Nkuri-Tomu village near Giyani. Officers on patrol received a complaint about a shooting and were directed to the house by the victim's brother-in-law; she was lying in the sitting room with multiple gunshot wounds to her head and upper body, with a steel axe and ammunition next to her, and was declared dead at the scene. Her 73-year-old husband was arrested at the house and a firearm seized; police say domestic violence has not been ruled out (police spokesperson Malesela Ledwaba, via Jacaranda FM). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: Jacaranda FM and Daily Sun. The pin is approximate (village level).
